source_title: MDOT T-2 — Information on the Movement of Oversize or Overweight Vehicles and Loads (10/2023)
verify_reasons: The MDOT T-2 sheet describes escort-vehicle equipment but does not publish the escort/pilot-car threshold matrix (which widths/heights/lengths require 1 vs 2 pilots or police). Confirm escort tiers with the MDOT Transport Permits Unit.

Legal gross weight is shown as the 80,000 lbs federal Interstate limit, but Michigan's axle-spacing weight law lets legal gross far exceed 80,000 lbs on designated non-Interstate state trunklines with enough properly spaced axles WITHOUT an overweight permit — confirm the exact legal gross for the actual axle configuration and route.

superload_thresholds.note: MDOT single-trip permits are not issued above 16' wide, 15' high, or 150' overall combination length; loads exceeding these are treated as superloads requiring a written explanation, MiTRIP application, and Route Survey Certification (Form 2465) to the Lansing Transport Permit Office at least 10 working days ahead. No fixed gross-weight superload number is published in T-2 (weight is governed by the axle-spacing law and route/bridge analysis).

single_trip.fee_formula: $15.00 for a load that is over-dimension only and legal in weight; $50.00 for a load that is over-dimension and/or over legal axle weight.
single_trip.note: Single trip permit valid for a 5-day period, one trip; a return move (same config or empty trailer, reversed route) may be requested within the same 5 days. Paid via the MDOT Permit Gateway (MPG) shopping cart.

annual.note: Extended (annual) renewal: $30 per unit over-dimension and legal in weight; $100 per unit overweight and/or over-dimension; Construction Equipment $264 per power unit. New extended applications are prorated. Not available to for-hire carriers.

movement_restrictions: Permits are issued for daylight hours only, Monday through Friday (½ hour before sunrise to ½ hour after sunset); other time limits may apply

No movement from 12:00 noon the day before, through daylight the first day after, New Year's, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas; three-day-weekend holidays extend the ban from noon before to daylight after
No overweight permits during the spring weight restriction period (except public emergency); no more than 11 axles during spring thaw
No permits for widths over 14' during the spring weight restriction period (except public emergency)
Routes over 13'6" high must be pre-verified by the applicant for vertical clearance
notes: Michigan's axle-spacing 'train' weight law allows legal gross well above 80,000 lbs on adequately spaced axle groups on designated state trunklines without an overweight permit; the 80,000 lbs legal_limits value reflects only the federal Interstate cap and is intentionally conservative.

Permits are not issued for doubles combinations. Wheel load cap 700 lbs/inch of tire tread (850 for empty self-propelled earth-movers). Single-trip caps by load type: Construction Equipment/Miscellaneous 16'w/15'h/150'L; International Sealed Container 8'6"w/13'6"h/60'L at 95,000 lbs (24,000 lbs single axle).
